text: 17-year-old male. The patient has been experiencing increasing pain and swelling in his right knee for the past 12 days. He reports pain with urination for the past 3 weeks and had a swollen, painful left ankle joint that resolved on its own about a week ago. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Reactive arthritis (Reiter's syndrome).

The combination of asymmetric oligoarthritis (knee and ankle), urethritis (painful urination), and recent sexual activity in a 17-year-old male is highly suggestive of Reactive Arthritis, potentially triggered by a gastrointestinal or genitourinary infection. Given your history, I would like to see the results of a Urinalysis and a test for Chlamydia to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis; REQUEST TEST: Chlamydia NAAT.
